metadata.title: Doxorubicin and Cyclophosphamide (AC 60/600) Therapy – 21 day
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: Doxorubicin bilirubin51 lies in both50% and25% bands. Source does not specify how bilirubin and AST reductions combine. Flag51 and competing actions for review; do not multiply reductions or silently infer a choice.
Educational / software source reconciliation is not consultant, pharmacy or clinical-use authorisation.

metadata.schedule_summary: Doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide on Day 1 every 21 days for four cycles. Any subsequent taxane follows a separately agreed regimen.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded action was triggered by the supplied values. Unassessed domains and the full prescribing review remain outstanding.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed. Missing phase, history or results are not assumed normal.
output_templates.consultant_review: Review the component-specific findings and source uncertainty before treatment.
output_templates.contraindicated: Do not administer the affected component(s); review the findings and exact regimen context.
output_templates.discontinue: Discontinue the affected component(s) identified below and obtain treating-clinician review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold the affected component(s) and assess the reported problem.
output_templates.delay: Delay the affected component(s) pending source-defined recovery and review.
output_templates.dose_reduce: A component-specific dose modification applies; verify the original and current doses before prescribing.
